This week's homework is to get down to work on your poster.
Remember that you need to have your poster for *August 4* and
that you need to make sure you are able to attend.

Also, to get your poster printed in time you will need to 
submit it by July 30.  You should share drafts of the poster
earlier with the RAs.

July 21 we have our Lehman in person day including working 
on your literature review and creating your poster.


Here is what the assignment says.

 - Run T-Test for your poster
 - From the chalkboard, watch videos on how to construct a poster
begin to assemble poster
 - Appropriate Header
 - Lit Review (at least 5 sources)
 - Theoretical Framework
 - Methods & Findings (with one data graphic)
 - Discussion, Conclusions, Limitations, and/or Future Research
 - At least one ‘content’ graphic/image
 - QR Code
 - Ideally your picture next to QR Code


For your poster you should already have a file called
poster.rmd in your rmarkdown folder.

*Do not use AI to do any of the writing.*   

## Must do this week

1. Edit your poster file and change the information at the 
top to be your name and information.  Your department 
should be whatever your major is.  

2. In the introduction section write a description of your 
topic.  This should include your population of interest and 
your dependent and independent variables. (All of this is a first
draft so it will get revised. This version will be very rough at this point.).

3. In the methods section write 1-2 sentences describing 
the RSS data. You can get the information you need from the links
on the icorp26 website. https://elinw.github.io/icorp26/

4. In the results section put the code to generate your 
tables and graphs.

5. Write some sentences summarizing the results.
